tierReason: Adds project data, new Prisma tables and new API endpoints, plus the offline sync layer

findings.text: queue.ts ~146-155 + routes.ts ~130 + ProjectsProvider.tsx ~134: an update is merged into a create whose response was lost (network after server stored it); the resent create returns the existing project unchanged and onApplied overwrites the local rename, so an offline rename is silently lost (R19, R25).

apps/mobile/src/app/(app)/projects/index.tsx: the project list never calls refresh() when shown (no useFocusEffect), so R17 'refresh whenever the project list is shown' isn't met; another member's delete/rename stays stale until foreground/reconnect.

apps/api/src/projects/routes.ts: no GET /projects/:id, so GET on a project falls to the generic notFoundHandler ('Not found.') while PATCH/DELETE say 'Project not found.'; AC10 asks reading, changing and deleting to give the same 404 body, and reading is untested.

apps/mobile/src/sync/queue.test.ts ~215 and ~237: AC26 test only checks onRejected + empty queue, not that the local copy shows the server's version / project removed on 404 and the notice is shown (ProjectsProvider logic untested); AC27 test never shows the change is sent after the same person signs in again.

queue.ts persist ~111 / load ~99: one rejected setJSON leaves the writes chain rejected forever, and a rejected first getJSON is cached in loading forever, so the queue stops working for the session; chain from writes.catch and reset loading on failure.
ProjectsProvider.tsx create ~319-330 (and update/remove): commit runs before queue.enqueue; if enqueue throws, the project is shown and cached but never queued, then vanishes at next refresh.
routes.ts ~105: GET /projects orderBy name has no tie-breaker; same-named projects can swap order between refreshes; add projectId asc.
store.test.ts ~36: 'a project missing from the server list is gone' calls applyOverlay([A], []) and expects [A]; it cannot fail, so AC19's 'refresh without B removes B' isn't really tested.
Repo root has no .gitignore; root node_modules/ shows as untracked and a git add -A would pick it up.

Sensitive: queue.ts runPass / ProjectsProvider flushInner: the queue never checks its ownerId against the signed-in user before sending; if setOwner fails or a flush queued before sign-in runs after it, user A's queued create could be sent with user B's token. Narrow window; fix by passing expected owner to flush or checking genRef before queue.flush().

Sensitive: queue.ts isPermanentRejection: 400 invalid_json/bad_request and 413 aren't permanent, and malformed persisted changes throw a TypeError treated as network; either one blocks the queue head forever. Treat all 4xx except 401/408/429 as permanent; validate persisted changes on load.
Sensitive: a delete resent after a lost reply gets 404 and shows 'couldn't be saved' though it worked; treat 404 on delete as success without a notice.
Sensitive: routes.ts requireOwner reads the role outside the write; once #5 adds role changes, a demoted Owner could still write in between. Before #5, put the owner condition in the write's where.
Sensitive: deleting a user leaves their projects with no members (reachable by nobody, ids 409 forever); handle when account deletion is built.
Sensitive: projects migration has no down script; additive only; undo by dropping ProjectMember, Project, ProjectRole, Currency; note in release notes.
Sensitive: GET /projects has no paging; out of scope by spec; record as a known limit.

Round 2: rejectedNotice is drawn only on Home with a current project; a 404 rejection on the current project clears currentProjectId, Home redirects to /projects which never shows it, and the stale notice later appears on an unrelated project (R26/AC26). Show it on the list too or in a shared (app) banner; clear on show/switch.

Round 2: outcomes.test.ts AC26 403 test asserts restoreFromServer([A,B],[]) equals [A,B], true regardless; the only thing restoring the server version is ProjectsProvider wiring (needsRefresh then refreshInner after flush), untested. Extract flush/apply/refresh into a plain function and test that after a 403 the list holds the server value; also that onSignedOut reaches handleNotSignedIn (AC27).
Round 2: edit.tsx delete sets deleting before an un-awaited remove(); if enqueue fails the screen renders null forever. Catch, reset deleting, show errors.generic.
Round 2: a refresh failing with 5xx silently sets status ready; list shows no error or retry.
Round 2: a change with no senders or a permanent 5xx stops the queue forever; consider a cap or way out.
Round 2: create sender sends one editedAt (latest) for all fields of a merged create; harmless now, not exactly per-field.
Round 2: AC22 has no test pinning the missing-sender type error (e.g. @ts-expect-error); AC16 language-independence is by design.
Round 2: new deps (async-storage, netinfo, expo-crypto, vitest) — approved in the plan by the user; retryProfile touches session handling, looks correct.

Round 3: edit.tsx 233-244 + ProjectsProvider update 313-333 + ProjectForm: the form submits all fields and update() diffs against the current cache, which a refresh may have changed while the form was open; a description-only save then queues the stale name with a fresh editedAt and reverts another device's newer rename (breaks R13). Diff against the form's initial values.
Round 3: AC16 'both app languages' not tested; formatMoney takes no language by design.
Round 3: AC19 removal only tested on applyOverlay; add a syncCycle refresh test where cache [A,B], server [A] leaves [A].
Round 3: syncCycle commits listProjects and create/patch replies to the cache without isProject checks; one malformed entry makes loadProjectCache discard the whole cache next launch (R18).
Round 3: outcomes.ts names the rejected notice after change.data.name (the rejected new name), not the project's known name.
Round 3: a non-network list refresh failure (5xx) shows no message.
Round 3: scope notes: retryProfile on foreground changes auth behaviour (state in PR); home greeting removed leaving home.welcome unused; root .gitignore and roadmap edits.
Round 3: spec R28 wipes the remembered project on sign-out, so R29/AC29 'opens the project used last' only happens after a 401, not a normal sign-out and sign-in; clarify AC29's by-hand step.

Round 4: projects/index.tsx and new.tsx call router.replace('/') after switching or creating; may leave an extra Home in the stack so Back shows Home again. Check by hand (Test Handoff); dismissTo('/') would avoid it.

Nav: edit.tsx:70 and :27 and [id]/index.tsx:28 use dismissTo('/projects'); POP_TO only replaces the top when the list isn't in the stack, so Home→card→Project→Edit→delete leaves [Home, Project(X), List]; back reaches the deleted project, which then redirects to the list again (R29a/R29b, AC29a/b). Reset the Home stack to [Home, List] via one shared helper.

Keyboard: ProjectForm renders Screen whose KeyboardAvoidingView has no keyboardVerticalOffset; under the Home stack header (and tabs) it underestimates the overlap by ~header+status bar, so the submit button likely stays hidden (R32/AC32). Pass useHeaderHeight() as the offset for screens under a header.

Nav: 'Switch project' via dismissTo replaces Project with the list when arrived from Home's card, so back goes to Home not Project (R29a 'opens on top'). Push the list when not in the stack, pop to it when it is.

Nav: a quick double tap can push the same screen twice (list row awaits setCurrentProject before push; Home card and Projects tile) — R29b forbids duplicates. Guard with a navigating ref or push before the awaited write.
R18/AC18: the Project details screen ([id]/index.tsx) shows no offline note; Home and the list do. Show the same note (shared OfflineNote) when status or profileStatus is offline.
Home card shows 'Create your first project' when there are projects but no current one; add a 'choose a project' state that opens the list.
After a 403 rejection, if the follow-up refresh fails the refused value stays in the persisted cache until a later refresh; keep needsRefresh across failed refreshes or roll back the refused fields.
GET /projects not paged: intentional per spec Out of Scope.
AC25 lacks an end-to-end syncCycle assertion that the local list equals the server response after an accepted PATCH.
Root .gitignore and roadmap edits beyond spec; new deps approved by the user in the plan.

R17/R18/R24: ProjectsProvider waits for profileStatus != loading before reading the cache; AuthProvider leaves profileStatus 'loading' forever when getMe fails with a non-network, non-401 error (e.g. 500/503 at launch), and retryProfile only handles 'offline'; so cached projects never show and the queue never sends. Also a stalled request delays the cache up to 15s.
queue.ts header says a change with attempts > 0 is never merged into or dropped; code only protects attempted creates. Correct the comment (behaviour is safe).
Unused i18n keys settings.accountTitle and home.welcome.

Privacy: ProjectsProvider effect 1 shows the stored cache before checking cache.userId against the signed-in user; after A's 401 keeps the cache, B signing in briefly sees A's projects until effect 2 clears them. cacheStep.show is tested but not used. Gate the display on cacheStep (or owner match).
Edit project push on the Project screen isn't wrapped in useTapOnce; a double tap can push two Edit screens (R29b).
listNav 'push' mode and its 'Switch project' test are now unused; remove or rename.
Home's waiting-changes note and the 'Choose a project' card aren't in the spec; settled with the user at QA as wanted.
After a 403 the notice names the project by its local (offline-edited) name, which is about to be reverted.

syncCycle.refresh: a non-401, non-network failure (500/502/503) sets status 'ready'; on a fresh phone with no cache Home invites 'Create your first project' to someone who has projects, and no note says the refresh failed. Treat as offline/error with retry; add a test.

HeaderBack icon size 28 and one-off inset/hitSlop break DESIGN.md (icons 20-22px, no one-off values); Home disabled tile uses opacity 0.55 and width 48% one-offs. Use tokens or record the exception in DESIGN.md.
Offline relaunch after A's 401 then B's sign-in killed before ownership clear can show A's cache while B's id is unknown; clear synchronously in startSession or store the token owner.
Sign-out cleanup swallows storage errors; data may stay on disk until the next different user's sign-in clears it.
A delete answered 404 is treated as done with no notice; deliberate deviation from R26 wording, note in Test Handoff.
Additions beyond spec: root .gitignore, retryProfile and treating non-401 profile failures as offline; mention in PR.
homeCard and the list show 'Create your first project' when offline with no cache (new phone + 503); show the invite only after a successful refresh, a neutral offline state otherwise.
A project created offline before any cache owner is known is saved with userId '' and hidden after an offline restart until online (R20 edge).
enqueue pushes into memory before persist; a storage failure leaves the change queued while create reports an error, so a retry can create a duplicate.

Scope beyond numbered requirements (identity colours, hero card, choose card, waiting line, stagger, retryProfile) and new deps incl. expo-linear-gradient: approved by the user at QA/design and in the plan.

queue.clear does not fence an in-flight runPass; A's POST returning after A signs out and B signs in runs onApplied and appends A's project to B's list and cache. Bump an epoch on clear/setOwner-drop and drop callbacks from an older epoch; test with a deferred sender.
flush(expectedOwnerId) during a running flush only sets rerun; the rerun uses the first caller's owner id, delaying B's changes after a switch. Keep the latest requested owner id for the rerun.
AC16 'both app languages' not exercised by a test; formatMoney takes no language by design.
Home banner dropped the current project's currency (R29/AC29 'name and currency'), also from its accessibility label.
Home 'Your projects' section isn't in R29 (user approved it in the mockup, spec not updated); its cards open a project without setCurrentProject, so Home keeps showing the old current project.
flush: when a pass stops on the epoch fence, rerun is cleared, dropping the new owner's requested flush (R24 delay); keep rerun for epoch stops and test that B's change is sent.
ProjectCard COVER_HEIGHT 92 and ICON_SIZE 30 are literals, not tokens.
Home banner: only the inner Open project button opens the project; tapping the banner itself does nothing (AC29 'tapping it opens'). Make the whole banner pressable.
After a 403, if the follow-up refresh fails, the next flush clears needsRefresh, so the refused value stays until a full sync; clear it only after a successful refresh.

AuthProvider: any non-401 profile error now counts as offline, plus a profile retry on foreground; session-handling change made during review to meet R17/R18/R24, approved with the plan addendum; stated in the PR.
GET /projects unpaged: deliberate, spec Out of Scope.
